_comment: Reference schema. Each subagent writes faculty/<slug>.json matching this shape. Do not edit by hand; regenerate the master sheet from these files.

program_meta.sop_limit: string - exact stated word/page limit, or 'not stated'
program_meta.extra_essays: string - e.g. separate personal/diversity statement and its limit
program_meta.english_test: string - include India exemption status if any
program_meta.advisor_model: string - are PhD students admitted to a specific advisor, to the dept, or via rotations?
program_meta.ms_research_access: string - can master's students join labs / do a thesis?

faculty.why_match: string - MUST name a specific result of Akshat's AND a specific paper of theirs
faculty.taking_students: string - Yes | No | Unstated, plus evidence and date
faculty.contact_policy: string - VERBATIM any instruction about emailing; 'not stated' if none
faculty.email: string - only if publicly listed; else 'not listed'
